breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully resolved the conflicting definitions for the grid. The incomplete prompt provided two incompatible ways to define `dx`. The agent correctly ignored the erroneous instruction (`dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)`) and followed the correct definition for a periodic domain (`dx=1/Nx`), which was also specified later in the prompt and is the sole definition present in the ground truth.
